review.summary: Reviewed merged PR #125 at head 278cf3d8e7374ddad0a7f7c4d2d57b3ef5ca03cf. Canonical tests now distinguish factory-configured from host-ready: Apptainer is configured by its registered factory, remains host-unready with placeholder pins, verifier-boundary open, non-selectable by a benchmark tuple, and exploratory.
